text.tspan: Where Kubernetes logs and metrics come from
Pod deleted or node gone → its log files are gone too, so ship them. Events last about 1 hour: export them for history.
Prometheus scrapes the kubelet (cAdvisor), kube-state-metrics and node_exporter. Traces: OpenTelemetry → Tempo / X-Ray.
